imp.csv_help: Fill the template in Google Sheets, then File → Download → CSV, and choose the file here. You'll see a preview before anything is saved.
imp.help_columns: Required for a new product: sku, name_en, price. Category: English name, sub-category as "Clothes > T-shirts" (created if missing).
imp.help_translate: Free Arabic translation in Google Sheets: in the name_ar column type
imp.help_variants: Options (size, color…): one row per option with the same SKU, using variant_en / variant_ar / variant_price / variant_stock.
imp.help_empty: For products that already exist, empty cells keep the current value. Every imported product is marked "Arabic needs review".

imp.bad_rows: {n} rows have problems (in red). Fix them in the spreadsheet and choose the file again.
imp.review_note: Nothing is saved until you press the button. If anything fails, nothing is imported.
imp.result: Done: {created} new, {updated} updated, options {vc} new / {vu} updated, {cats} new categories.
imp.err_no_sku_column: The file has no "sku" column. Use the template.
imp.photos_help: Select many photos at once. Name each file after the product SKU: SKU.jpg is the main photo, SKU_2.jpg, SKU_3.jpg… are the next ones. Uploading the same name again replaces the photo.
imp.photo_err_type: not a photo file (jpg, png, webp)
imp.help_extra: Optional columns: search_keywords (Arabizi / other spellings, e.g. "tawle, kursi"), measurements_en and measurements_ar.

shop.privacy_default:
We only ask for what we need to deliver your order: your name, phone number and address (and a location link if you share one).

We use them to prepare and deliver your order and to contact you about it, for example on WhatsApp. We never sell or share them for advertising.

When our driver is on the way to you, you can see his position on the tracking page; it is shown only during your delivery.

To see or delete your details, contact us on WhatsApp.

set.readonly: View only: ask Mika or Charbel to change settings.
set.texts_intro: Edit customer-facing wording here. Leave optional notes empty to hide them; an empty WhatsApp template uses its built-in message. Screen labels and buttons stay fixed.
set.f_unpaid_cancel_hours: Cancel unpaid Whish / OMT orders after (hours)
set.h_shop_name_en: Shown at the top of the shop, on slips and in messages.
set.h_shop_name_ar: Shown when the shop is in Arabic.
set.h_currency: As customers should see it, e.g. USD or $.
set.h_whatsapp_number: Customers contact you here. Also used by the "Call us" button. Empty = no WhatsApp / Call buttons.
set.h_whish_number: Empty = Whish is not offered at checkout.
set.h_omt_details: Shown to customers as written (name, number, branch...). Empty = OMT is not offered.
set.h_unpaid_cancel_hours: Stock comes back automatically. Empty or 0 = never cancel automatically.
set.h_order_prefix: Up to 6 letters, digits or "-", e.g. MS- → MS-10001. Applies to new orders.
set.h_low_stock_threshold: Products with this many or fewer left get a "low" warning in the admin. Empty = off.
set.h_privacy_en: Shown on the Privacy page. Empty = a standard text is shown.
set.h_privacy_ar: Shown on the Privacy page in Arabic. Empty = a standard text is shown.
set.h_shop_intro_en: Shown near the top of the home page. Optional.
set.h_shop_intro_ar: Shown on the Arabic home page. Optional.
set.h_delivery_payment_en: Shown at checkout near delivery and payment choices. Optional.
set.h_delivery_payment_ar: Shown there when the shop is in Arabic. Optional.
set.h_checkout_note_en: A short note near the place-order button. Optional.
set.h_checkout_note_ar: Shown there when the shop is in Arabic. Optional.
set.h_order_confirmation_en: Shown after the order number on the confirmation page. Optional.
set.h_order_confirmation_ar: Shown there when the shop is in Arabic. Optional.
set.h_whatsapp_ask_en: Product question template. Empty uses the built-in message. You can use {name}, {sku}, and {url}.
set.h_whatsapp_ask_ar: Arabic product question template. Empty uses the built-in message. You can use {name}, {sku}, and {url}.
set.h_whatsapp_share_en: Product share template. Empty uses the built-in message. You can use {name}.
set.h_whatsapp_share_ar: Arabic product share template. Empty uses the built-in message. You can use {name}.
set.h_whatsapp_order_en: Order contact template. Empty uses the built-in message. You can use {no}.
set.h_whatsapp_order_ar: Arabic order contact template. Empty uses the built-in message. You can use {no}.
set.h_whatsapp_status_en: Shown when staff send an update. You can use {name}, {no}, {status}, and {url}.
set.h_whatsapp_status_ar: Arabic status update. You can use {name}, {no}, {status}, and {url}.
set.h_whish_checkout_en: Under "Whish" when the customer chooses how to pay. You can use {number}. Empty = the standard sentence.
set.h_whish_checkout_ar: The same in Arabic. You can use {number}. Empty = the standard sentence.
set.h_whish_confirm_en: On the order confirmation page. You can use {total}, {number} and {no} (order number). Empty = the standard sentence.
set.h_whish_confirm_ar: The same in Arabic. You can use {total}, {number} and {no}. Empty = the standard sentence.
set.h_omt_checkout_en: Under "OMT" when the customer chooses how to pay. You can use {details} (the OMT details above). Empty = just the OMT details.
set.h_omt_checkout_ar: The same in Arabic. You can use {details}. Empty = just the OMT details.
set.h_omt_confirm_en: On the order confirmation page, above the OMT details. You can use {total} and {no} (order number). Empty = the standard sentence.
set.h_omt_confirm_ar: The same in Arabic. You can use {total} and {no}. Empty = the standard sentence.
set.h_footer_note_en: A short note below the shop contact links. Optional.
set.h_footer_note_ar: Shown there when the shop is in Arabic. Optional.
